integrity: A complete integral mathematical argument and reproducible exact finite checks are supplied; no independent mathematical certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: For order at least five and color-preserving autotopisms only; this gives a primitive integral presentation but does not establish equivariant splitting or paratopism representations. Finite checks do not prove infinite statements; independent validation is not performed.
title: An integral autotopism presentation for Latin-square clique homology
